name: Clouded Leopard
source:
A clouded leopard from the Rukai, with a tattoo of Hundred Pacers on his body. 

A subordinate of the King of Hundred Pacers (aka. master of the dead), Aidridringane. The leopard brought spirits of the dead to view a performance and met Liao there. Sensing the potential within Liao, he wanted to convince Liao to deal with the problems that have been troubling his people for a long time. 

He often does things without thinking but believes in the conviction of his morals and is extremely determined. He doesn’t know Mandarin Chinese so communication can be difficult, leading him to come off as cold at times but truly he is a passionate and sensitive person.

[From [url=https://www.nekojishi.tw/en-char.html]official site[/url]]
